38	def resolve_hf_token(token: str | None, token_env: str | None) -> str | None:
39	    """Explicit ``token`` > configured ``token_env`` > standard HF env vars."""
40	    if token:
41	        return token
42	    candidates = [token_env] if token_env else []
43	    candidates += list(_HF_TOKEN_ENVS)
44	    for name in candidates:
45	        val = name and os.environ.get(name)
46	        if val:
47	            return val
48	    return None

243	    @staticmethod
244	    def _stage_knowledge(src: Path, dst: Path) -> None:
245	        """Copy the knowledge tree (lessons/patches/stats) into the upload staging.
246	
247	        Only lightweight text artifacts (``.jsonl``/``.patch``/``.json``) are shipped;
248	        the snapshot cache and any binaries are excluded.
249	        """
250	        import shutil
251	
252	        keep = (".jsonl", ".patch", ".json")
253	        for p in src.rglob("*"):
254	            if not p.is_file() or p.suffix not in keep:
255	                continue
256	            rel = p.relative_to(src)
257	            out = dst / rel
258	            out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
259	            shutil.copy2(p, out)

262	                       commit_message: str | None = None) -> None:
263	        from huggingface_hub.utils import HfHubHTTPError
264	        try:
265	            api.upload_folder(
266	                repo_id=self.repo,

316	def build_model_card(meta: RunMeta, *, repo_name: str, results: dict[str, float] | None = None) -> str:
317	    """Render a compact README.md model card for a quantized model repo."""
318	    base = meta.model or "Unknown"
319	    scheme = meta.scheme or "Unknown"
320	    method_key = (meta.method or "").lower()
321	    method_display, method_url = _METHOD_LINKS.get(method_key, (meta.method or "Unknown", None))
322	    gen_by = f"[{method_display}]({method_url})" if method_url else method_display
323	    tags = ["quantized", scheme.lower(), method_display.lower(), "autoquant-agent"]
324	    lines = [
325	        "---",
326	        "base_model:",
327	        f"- {base}",
328	        "pipeline_tag: text-generation",
329	        "tags:",
330	        *[f"- {t}" for t in tags],
331	        "---",
332	        "",
333	        f"# {repo_name}",
334	        "",
335	        "## Model Details",
336	        "",
337	        (f"This is a **{scheme}** quantization of "
338	         f"[{base}](https://huggingface.co/{base}), generated by {gen_by}. "
339	         "Please follow the license of the original model."),
340	        "",
341	        "## Quantization Details",
342	        "",
343	        f"- **Scheme:** {scheme}",
344	        f"- **Method:** {method_display}",
345	        f"- **Base model:** [{base}](https://huggingface.co/{base})",
346	    ]
347	    if results:
348	        lines += ["", "## Evaluation", "", "| Benchmark | Score |", "|---|---|"]
349	        lines += [f"| {name} | {score:.4f} |" for name, score in sorted(results.items())]
350	    lines += ["", ("_Produced with [autoquant-agent](https://github.com/) — "
351	              "agent-driven quantize + evaluate + self-heal._"), ""]
352	    return "\n".join(lines)

355	class HfModelSink:
356	    """Upload a **quantized model** to a Hugging Face *model* repo.
357	
358	    Minimal single-token/single-org port of local_dispatch's ``upload_model_hf.py``:
359	    ``create_repo`` + ``upload_folder`` (with secret/log ignore patterns) plus a
360	    generated model card.  Multi-account failover + quota ledger are intentionally
361	    left out of this first version.
362	
363	    Unlike the result sinks, ``upload``'s first arg is the **model directory**
364	    (the quantized checkpoint), not the eval run dir; the pipeline invokes it with
365	    the quantize provider's output.
366	    """
367	
368	    name = "hf_model"
369	
370	    def __init__(
371	        self,
372	        repo: str | None = None,          # org / owner the repo lives under
373	        *,
374	        repo_name: str | None = None,     # repo id under `repo`; default = artifact name
375	        token: str | None = None,
376	        token_env: str | None = None,
377	        private: bool = False,
378	        endpoint: str | None = None,
379	        disable_xet: bool = False,
380	        model_card: bool = True,
381	        **_: Any,
382	    ):
383	        self.repo = repo
384	        self.repo_name = repo_name
385	        self.token = token
386	        self.token_env = token_env
387	        self.private = private
388	        self.endpoint = endpoint
389	        self.disable_xet = disable_xet
390	        self.model_card = model_card
391	
392	    def _resolve_token(self) -> str | None:
393	        return resolve_hf_token(self.token, self.token_env)
394	
395	    def upload(self, model_dir: Path, meta: RunMeta) -> str:
396	        if not self.repo:
397	            raise AqaError("hf_model sink requires a `repo` (the org/owner to upload under)")
398	        model_dir = Path(model_dir)
399	        if not model_dir.is_dir():
400	            raise AqaError(f"hf_model: model directory not found: {model_dir}")
401	        try:
402	            from huggingface_hub import HfApi
403	            from huggingface_hub.utils import HfHubHTTPError
404	        except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - optional dep
405	            raise AqaError("hf_model sink needs `huggingface_hub`") from exc
406	
407	        token = self._resolve_token()
408	        if not token:
409	            raise AqaError(
410	                "hf_model upload has no token. Set HF_TOKEN (forwarded into the "
411	                "remote container) or configure `token_env: <VAR>` on the sink. The "
412	                f"token must have *write* access under '{self.repo}'."
413	            )
414	        if self.disable_xet:
415	            os.environ.setdefault("HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET", "1")
416	
417	        repo_name = self.repo_name or meta.artifact_name or model_dir.name
418	        repo_id = f"{self.repo}/{repo_name}"
419	
420	        if self.model_card:
421	            self._write_model_card(model_dir, meta, repo_name)
422	
423	        api = HfApi(token=token, endpoint=self.endpoint)
424	        try:
425	            api.create_repo(repo_id=repo_id, token=token, repo_type="model",
426	                            exist_ok=True, private=self.private)
427	            api.upload_folder(
428	                repo_id=repo_id, repo_type="model", folder_path=str(model_dir),
429	                token=token, ignore_patterns=_MODEL_IGNORE_PATTERNS,
430	                commit_message=f"Upload quantized model {repo_name}",
431	            )
432	        except HfHubHTTPError as exc:
433	            status = getattr(getattr(exc, "response", None), "status_code", None)
434	            if status == 403:
435	                raise AqaError(
436	                    f"hf_model upload to '{repo_id}' was denied (403). The token "
437	                    "reached HF but lacks *write* permission under this org/owner. "
438	                    "Use a token whose account can write to "
439	                    f"'{self.repo}' (create/write scope)."
440	                ) from exc
441	            raise AqaError(f"hf_model upload to '{repo_id}' failed: {exc}") from exc
442	        url = f"https://huggingface.co/{repo_id}"
443	        _log.info("quantized model uploaded to %s", url)
444	        return url
445	
446	    def _write_model_card(self, model_dir: Path, meta: RunMeta, repo_name: str) -> None:
447	        results = meta.extra.get("results") if isinstance(meta.extra, dict) else None
448	        try:
449	            (model_dir / "README.md").write_text(
450	                build_model_card(meta, repo_name=repo_name, results=results), encoding="utf-8")
451	        except OSError as exc:  # never block the upload on a card write
452	            _log.warning("hf_model: could not write model card: %s", exc)

44	class HealTally:
45	    """Accumulates the agent self-heal effort spent to *produce* a green run.
46	
47	    The escalating agent fix-loop contributes here, per phase, so the reproducibility
48	    manifest can report how much effort (turns + best-effort tokens) a score cost.
49	    ``record_deterministic`` is retained for backward compat with the manifest schema
50	    (agent-written eval overrides are surfaced via ``EvalResult.healed`` instead).
51	    """
52	
53	    _phases: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
54	
55	    def _slot(self, phase: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
56	        from .agent_eval.stats import TokenStats
57	        return self._phases.setdefault(
58	            phase, {"agent_attempts": 0, "deterministic_heals": 0,
59	                    "tiers": 0, "tokens": TokenStats()})
60	
61	    def record_fix(self, phase: str, fr: FixResult) -> None:
62	        slot = self._slot(phase)
63	        slot["agent_attempts"] += fr.attempts
64	        if fr.attempts:
65	            slot["tiers"] = max(slot["tiers"], fr.tier_index + 1)
66	        slot["tokens"].merge(fr.tokens)
67	
68	    def record_deterministic(self, phase: str, applied: list[str]) -> None:
69	        self._slot(phase)["deterministic_heals"] += len(applied)
70	
71	    def block(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
72	        """Aggregate a manifest ``self_heal`` block (None when no heal happened)."""
73	        from .agent_eval.stats import TokenStats
74	        total_attempts = sum(p["agent_attempts"] for p in self._phases.values())
75	        total_det = sum(p["deterministic_heals"] for p in self._phases.values())
76	        tokens = TokenStats()
77	        for p in self._phases.values():
78	            tokens.merge(p["tokens"])
79	        if total_attempts == 0 and total_det == 0 and tokens.is_empty():
80	            return None
81	        per_phase: dict[str, Any] = {}
82	        for name, p in self._phases.items():
83	            if not (p["agent_attempts"] or p["deterministic_heals"]):

85	            entry: dict[str, Any] = {
86	                "agent_attempts": p["agent_attempts"],

89	            }
90	            if not p["tokens"].is_empty():
91	                entry["tokens"] = p["tokens"].to_dict()

95	            "deterministic_heals": total_det,
96	            "per_phase": per_phase,

270	def _run_evaluate(run_cfg: RunConfig, model: str, eval_dir: Path,
271	                  out_dir: Path, num_gpus: int, knowledge=None,
272	                  run_id: str = "", phase_name: str = "evaluate",
273	                  heal: HealTally | None = None) -> EvalResult:
274	    """Evaluate, wrapping the phase in the agent fix-loop when enabled.
275	
276	    A phase is considered failed when the harness raises OR every benchmark scores
277	    exactly 0 (acc=0 => fail, matching the leaderboard's failure heuristic). On
278	    failure the fix-loop hands the agent the full traceback and lets it decide --
279	    there is no deterministic pre-pass.
280	    """
281	    holder: dict[str, EvalResult] = {}
282	
283	    def _phase() -> PhaseResult:
284	        try:
285	            res = run_evaluation(model, run_cfg.eval, eval_dir, num_gpus=num_gpus)
286	        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surface as a fixable phase failure
287	            return PhaseResult(ok=False, log_text=str(exc))
288	        holder["result"] = res
289	        if not res.benchmarks:
290	            return PhaseResult(ok=False, log_text="evaluation produced no benchmark results")
291	        # after_benchmark validator hooks (e.g. eval_sanity): an AqaError verdict
292	        # fails the phase and feeds the fix-loop's error signature.
293	        registry = BenchmarkRegistry()
294	        try:
295	            for bench in res.benchmarks.values():
296	                run_hooks("after_benchmark", run_cfg, recipe=registry.get(bench.name),
297	                          result_or_exception=bench, out_dir=eval_dir)
298	        except AqaError as exc:
299	            return PhaseResult(ok=False, log_text=str(exc))
300	        if all(b.score == 0 for b in res.benchmarks.values()):
301	            return PhaseResult(ok=False, log_text="all benchmark scores are 0 (acc=0 => fail)")
302	        return PhaseResult(ok=True)
303	
304	    if not run_cfg.agent.fix_loop:
305	        return run_evaluation(model, run_cfg.eval, eval_dir, num_gpus=num_gpus)
306	
307	    fr = run_fix_loop(
308	        phase_name, _phase, config=_fix_config(run_cfg), out_dir=out_dir,
309	        model_id=run_cfg.model,
310	        scheme=run_cfg.quant.scheme if run_cfg.quant else "",
311	        method=run_cfg.quant.method if run_cfg.quant else "",
312	        patch_capture=_make_patch_capture(run_cfg, out_dir),
313	        knowledge=knowledge, replay=run_cfg.agent.knowledge.replay, run_id=run_id,
314	    )
315	    if heal is not None:
316	        heal.record_fix(phase_name, fr)
317	    if "result" not in holder:
318	        raise AqaError(f"evaluate failed after fix-loop: {fr.reason}")
319	    if not fr.ok:
320	        _log.warning("evaluate fix-loop unresolved (%s); using last result", fr.reason)
321	    return holder["result"]

345	def run_pipeline(run_cfg: RunConfig, out_dir: Path) -> ProcessState:
346	    """Execute the full pipeline; returns terminal ProcessState.
347	
348	    On a phase failure (quantize/evaluate raises after the fix-loop) the run's
349	    artifacts are still written back: eval logs, agent fix records and captured
350	    patches are uploaded via the configured sinks with a failure ``status`` (so a
351	    crashed run is observable on the leaderboard instead of silently vanishing),
352	    and if a valid quantized checkpoint exists it is still pushed to its model
353	    repo. The original error is then re-raised so the caller still sees rc!=0.
354	    """
355	    num_gpus = _num_gpus(run_cfg)
356	    run_id = _make_run_id(run_cfg)
357	    baseline: EvalResult | None = None
358	    resolved = None
359	    eval_dir = out_dir / "eval"
360	    heal = HealTally()
361	    # Shared fix-knowledge (lessons + replayable patches); synced down once here.
362	    knowledge = _make_knowledge(run_cfg)
363	
364	    try:
365	        # ── optional bf16 baseline evaluation ────────────────────────────────
366	        if run_cfg.eval.baseline:
367	            _log.info("== baseline eval (bf16) ==")
368	            base_dir = out_dir / "baseline"
369	            baseline = _run_evaluate(run_cfg, run_cfg.model, base_dir, out_dir,
370	                                     num_gpus, knowledge, run_id,
371	                                     phase_name="baseline", heal=heal)
372	            write_accuracy_json(baseline, base_dir)
373	            _dispatch_sinks(run_cfg, base_dir, RunMeta(
374	                model=run_cfg.model, artifact_name=_artifact_name(run_cfg, "baseline")))
375	
376	        # ── resolve the eval target (provider: pretrained|quantize|endpoint) ──
377	        resolved = _resolve_model(run_cfg, out_dir, num_gpus, knowledge, run_id,
378	                                  heal=heal)
379	        eval_model = resolved.model
380	
381	        # ── evaluation of the (provided) model ───────────────────────────────
382	        _log.info("== evaluate ==")
383	        result = _run_evaluate(run_cfg, eval_model, eval_dir, out_dir, num_gpus,
384	                               knowledge, run_id, heal=heal)
385	        write_accuracy_json(result, eval_dir)
386	
387	        # ── gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
388	        gate_verdict: str | None = None
389	        if run_cfg.gate is not None:
390	            decision = evaluate_gate(result, baseline, run_cfg.gate)
391	            gate_verdict = decision.verdict
392	            (out_dir / "gate.json").write_text(
393	                __import__("json").dumps({"verdict": decision.verdict, "reasons": decision.reasons},
394	                                         indent=2))
395	            _log.info("gate: %s (%s)", decision.verdict, "; ".join(decision.reasons))
396	
397	        results = {n: b.score for n, b in result.benchmarks.items()}
398	
399	        # ── reproducibility manifest (model + config + env + results) ────────
400	        manifest = build_manifest(
401	            run_cfg, result, run_id=run_id, baseline=baseline,
402	            gate_verdict=gate_verdict, out_dir=out_dir, self_heal=heal.block())
403	        write_manifest(manifest, out_dir)
404	
405	        _write_terminal_state(out_dir, ProcessState.DONE, run_cfg.model)
406	        _dispatch_sinks(run_cfg, eval_dir, RunMeta(
407	            model=run_cfg.model,
408	            scheme=run_cfg.quant.scheme if run_cfg.quant else None,
409	            method=run_cfg.quant.method if run_cfg.quant else None,
410	            artifact_name=_artifact_name(run_cfg, "quant"),
411	            run_root=out_dir,
412	            run_id=run_id,
413	            status=_derive_status(results, gate_verdict),
414	            extra={"results": results},
415	            knowledge_dir=knowledge.local_dir if knowledge else None,
416	        ))
417	
418	        # ── optional: upload the quantized checkpoint to a HF model repo ──────
419	        _maybe_upload_model(run_cfg, resolved, result, out_dir)
420	        _finalize_knowledge(knowledge)
421	        return ProcessState.DONE
422	    except AqaError as exc:
423	        _writeback_on_failure(run_cfg, out_dir, eval_dir, resolved, exc, knowledge,
424	                              run_id=run_id, heal=heal)
425	        _finalize_knowledge(knowledge)
426	        raise

444	def _writeback_on_failure(run_cfg: RunConfig, out_dir: Path, eval_dir: Path,

447	    """Best-effort write-back of a *failed* run (results/logs/patches + status).
448

450	    marked failed on the leaderboard.  If quantization succeeded but evaluation
451	    failed, a valid checkpoint may still exist -- it is uploaded too.  All errors
452	    here are swallowed (we are already unwinding a failure and must re-raise).
453	    """
454	    reason = str(exc)

464	            extra_env={"failure": {"status": status, "reason": reason[:500]}},

473	            method=run_cfg.quant.method if run_cfg.quant else None,

475	            run_root=out_dir,
476	            run_id=run_id,
477	            status=status,
478	            extra={"results": {}, "error": reason},

1	"""Stage a run directory for upload: exclude model weights / caches and scrub
2	secrets from text artifacts.
3	
4	Ported from ``local_dispatch/upload_results_hf_dataset.py`` so the aqa results
5	sink writes back the *same* shape local_dispatch did (logs, agent fix records,
6	patches, summaries), minus the quantized weights, with secrets redacted.
7	"""
8	
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import os
12	import re
13	import shutil
14	from pathlib import Path
15	
16	# Suffixes we sanitize as UTF-8 text; everything else is copied byte-for-byte.
17	TEXT_SUFFIXES = {
18	    ".json", ".jsonl", ".log", ".md", ".txt", ".sh", ".py",
19	    ".yaml", ".yml", ".patch", ".diff", ".csv", ".cfg", ".ini",
20	}
21	
22	# Directories that must never be uploaded (weights + caches + vcs).
23	EXCLUDED_DIRS = {
24	    "quantized", "quantized_model", "__pycache__", ".git", ".cache",
25	    ".pytest_cache", ".venv", "venv",
26	}
27	
28	# Weight/blob files that may live outside a weights dir.
29	EXCLUDED_SUFFIXES = {
30	    ".safetensors", ".bin", ".pt", ".pth", ".gguf", ".onnx", ".h5", ".ckpt",
31	}
32	
33	SECRET_PATTERNS = (
34	    re.compile(r"hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}"),
35	    # GitHub token family: ghp_ (personal), gho_ (OAuth), ghu_ (user-to-server),
36	    # ghs_ (server-to-server), ghr_ (refresh), github_pat_ (fine-grained).
37	    re.compile(r"(?:ghp|gho|ghu|ghs|ghr|github_pat)_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}"),
38	    re.compile(r"glpat-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{15,}"),
39	    re.compile(r"\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b"),
40	    re.compile(r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}"),
41	    re.compile(r"(?i)(authorization\s*[:=]\s*bearer\s+)[^\s\"']+"),
42	    re.compile(r"(?i)(x-access-token:***REDACTED***@\s/]+"),
43	    # generic credentials in URL userinfo: scheme://user:secret@host
44	    re.compile(r"(https?://[^/\s:@]+:)[^@\s/]+(@)"),
45	)
46	
47	
48	def sanitize_text(text: str) -> str:
49	    """Redact tokens/secrets from a text artifact before it leaves the machine."""
50	    for pattern in SECRET_PATTERNS:
51	        if pattern.groups:
52	            def _sub(m: re.Match, n: int = pattern.groups) -> str:
53	                # keep every capture group, inserting the redaction after group 1
54	                return m.group(1) + "***REDACTED***" + "".join(
55	                    m.group(i) or "" for i in range(2, n + 1))
56	            text = pattern.sub(_sub, text)
57	        else:
58	            text = pattern.sub("***REDACTED***", text)
59	    return text
60	
61	
62	def stage_run_artifacts(
63	    src: Path,
64	    dst: Path,
65	    *,
66	    extra_excluded_dirs: set[str] | None = None,
67	    sanitize: bool = True,
68	) -> list[str]:
69	    """Copy ``src`` into ``dst`` excluding weights/caches and scrubbing text.
70	
71	    Returns the list of copied paths (relative to ``src``).
72	    """
73	    src = Path(src)
74	    dst = Path(dst)
75	    excluded = set(EXCLUDED_DIRS)
76	    if extra_excluded_dirs:
77	        excluded |= set(extra_excluded_dirs)
78	    copied: list[str] = []
79	    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(src):
80	        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in excluded]
81	        root_path = Path(root)
82	        rel_root = root_path.relative_to(src)
83	        for name in files:
84	            source = root_path / name
85	            if source.suffix.lower() in EXCLUDED_SUFFIXES:
86	                continue
87	            rel = rel_root / name
88	            target = dst / rel
89	            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
90	            if sanitize and source.suffix.lower() in TEXT_SUFFIXES:
91	                try:
92	                    text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
93	                    target.write_text(sanitize_text(text), encoding="utf-8")
94	                except OSError:
95	                    continue
96	            else:
97	                try:
98	                    shutil.copy2(source, target)
99	                except OSError:
100	                    continue
101	            copied.append(str(rel))
102	    return copied

1	"""Reproducibility manifest: freeze *how* an eval run was produced.
2	
3	A :class:`RunManifest` is the NeMo-Evaluator-style record that makes a score
4	reproducible: the model + quant fingerprint, the exact eval configuration
5	(benchmarks, harness, sampling params, seed, few-shot), an environment
6	fingerprint (key dependency versions + accelerator), the results (with clean
7	denominators), and a re-runnable command.  It is written next to the accuracy
8	json and rides the results dataset, so anyone can diff two manifests to see
9	*why* two W4A16 numbers differ (seed / vllm version / few-shot) instead of
10	guessing.
11	
12	The module is pure + dependency-light (only stdlib + the run config/result it is
13	handed) so it is unit-tested without a real run.
14	"""
15	
16	from __future__ import annotations
17	
18	import json
19	import platform
20	import sys
21	from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
22	from datetime import datetime, timezone
23	from importlib import metadata
24	from pathlib import Path
25	from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
26	
27	if TYPE_CHECKING:  # pragma: no cover
28	    from ..config import RunConfig
29	    from ..eval.registry import EvalResult

32	
33	# Dependency versions worth pinning for reproducibility (quant + eval stack).
34	_TRACKED_PACKAGES = (
35	    "autoquant-agent", "torch", "transformers", "auto-round", "auto_round",
36	    "lm-eval", "lm_eval", "vllm", "accelerate", "datasets", "huggingface-hub",
37	)

40	def _package_versions() -> dict[str, str]:
41	    """Best-effort ``{package: version}`` for the tracked stack (installed only)."""
42	    seen: dict[str, str] = {}
43	    for name in _TRACKED_PACKAGES:
44	        try:
45	            seen[name] = metadata.version(name)
46	        except metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
47	            continue
48	    return seen

51	def _accelerator(run_cfg: RunConfig) -> dict[str, Any]:
52	    ssh = run_cfg.executor.ssh
53	    if ssh is not None:
54	        gpus = [g for g in ssh.gpus.split(",") if g.strip()]
55	        return {"family": ssh.accelerator, "num_devices": len(gpus) or 1,
56	                "executor": run_cfg.executor.type, "remote": True}
57	    return {"family": "cpu/local", "num_devices": 1,

61	def _reproduce_command(config_path: str | None) -> str:
62	    if config_path:

67	def record_quant_command(out_dir: Path, command: str, *, source: str) -> None:
68	    """Persist the *actual* quantize command so the manifest can capture it.
69	
70	    Written by the pipeline where the command is known (builder output or an
71	    agent-optimized recipe), then read back in :func:`build_manifest` -- the
72	    quantize phase runs behind the provider boundary, so a small file-drop is
73	    the least-coupled way to surface the executed command to the manifest.
74	    """
75	    try:
76	        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
77	        (out_dir / _QUANT_COMMAND_FILE).write_text(
78	            json.dumps({"command": command, "source": source}, ensure_ascii=False),
79	            encoding="utf-8")
80	    except OSError:  # pragma: no cover - best-effort provenance
81	        pass
82	
83	
84	def _load_quant_command(out_dir: Path) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
85	    path = out_dir / _QUANT_COMMAND_FILE
86	    if not path.is_file():
87	        return None
88	    try:
89	        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
90	    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):  # pragma: no cover
91	        return None

94	_QUANT_COMMAND_FILE = ".quant_command.json"

97	@dataclass
98	class RunManifest:
99	    """Everything needed to reproduce (and audit) one eval run's numbers."""
100	
101	    schema_version: str
102	    created_at: str
103	    run_id: str
104	    model: dict[str, Any]
105	    quant: dict[str, Any] | None
106	    eval: dict[str, Any]
107	    environment: dict[str, Any]
108	    results: dict[str, Any]
109	    gate: dict[str, Any] | None = None
110	    commands: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
111	    reproduce: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
112	
113	    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
114	        return asdict(self)
115	
116	
117	def build_manifest(
118	    run_cfg: RunConfig,
119	    result: EvalResult,
120	    *,
121	    run_id: str,
122	    config_path: str | None = None,
123	    baseline: EvalResult | None = None,
124	    gate_verdict: str | None = None,
125	    extra_env: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
126	    out_dir: Path | None = None,
127	    usage: Any = None,
128	    self_heal: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
129	) -> RunManifest:
130	    """Assemble a :class:`RunManifest` from the run config + eval result.
131	
132	    ``usage`` (an ``AgentEvalResult``, optional) contributes the agent
133	    efficiency block -- token + turn totals -- for agentic benchmarks; when
134	    omitted, efficiency is derived from any per-benchmark provenance the
135	    ``EvalResult`` itself carries.  ``self_heal`` records the agent effort the
136	    pipeline spent *producing* this run (fix-loop attempts + tokens), so the cost
137	    of reaching a green run is auditable next to the score.
138	    """
139	    quant = run_cfg.quant.model_dump() if run_cfg.quant is not None else None
140	
141	    lm = run_cfg.eval.lm_eval
142	    eval_block: dict[str, Any] = {
143	        "benchmarks": list(run_cfg.eval.benchmarks),
144	        "backend": run_cfg.eval.backend,
145	        "harness": run_cfg.eval.harness,
146	        "batch_size": run_cfg.eval.batch_size,
147	        "limit": run_cfg.eval.limit,
148	        "seed": lm.seed,
149	        "gen_max_toks": run_cfg.eval.gen_max_toks,
150	        "generative_tasks": list(run_cfg.eval.generative_tasks),
151	        "apply_chat_template": lm.apply_chat_template,
152	        "fewshot_as_multiturn": lm.fewshot_as_multiturn,
153	        "model_args": dict(lm.model_args),
154	        "gen_kwargs": dict(lm.gen_kwargs),
155	        "baseline": run_cfg.eval.baseline,
156	    }
157	
158	    results_block: dict[str, Any] = {
159	        "mean_score": result.mean_score(),
160	        "backend": result.backend,
161	        "benchmarks": {
162	            name: {"score": b.score, "metric": b.metric, "num_samples": b.num_samples}
163	            for name, b in result.benchmarks.items()
164	        },
165	    }
166	    if baseline is not None:
167	        results_block["baseline"] = {
168	            "mean_score": baseline.mean_score(),
169	            "benchmarks": {
170	                name: {"score": b.score, "metric": b.metric}
171	                for name, b in baseline.benchmarks.items()
172	            },
173	        }
174	
175	    efficiency = _efficiency_block(result, usage)
176	    if efficiency is not None:
177	        results_block["efficiency"] = efficiency
178	    if self_heal:
179	        results_block["self_heal"] = self_heal
180	
181	    environment: dict[str, Any] = {
182	        "python": platform.python_version(),
183	        "platform": platform.platform(),
184	        "executable": sys.executable,
185	        "packages": _package_versions(),
186	        "accelerator": _accelerator(run_cfg),
187	    }
188	    if extra_env:
189	        environment.update(extra_env)
190	
191	    gate = {"verdict": gate_verdict} if gate_verdict is not None else None
192	
193	    commands = _commands_block(result, out_dir)
194	
195	    return RunManifest(
196	        schema_version=SCHEMA_VERSION,
197	        created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
198	        run_id=run_id,
199	        model={"id": run_cfg.model, "provider": run_cfg.provider.type},
200	        quant=quant,
201	        eval=eval_block,
202	        environment=environment,
203	        results=results_block,
204	        gate=gate,
205	        commands=commands,
206	        reproduce={"command": _reproduce_command(config_path), "config": config_path},
207	    )
208	
209	
210	def _efficiency_block(result: EvalResult, usage: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
211	    """Token + turn efficiency for the manifest (agent cost alongside the score).
212	
213	    Prefers an explicit ``AgentEvalResult`` (``usage``); otherwise falls back to
214	    provenance the ``EvalResult`` carries on its agentic benchmarks. Returns
215	    ``None`` for a pure lm_eval run so the block never appears empty.
216	    """
217	    if usage is not None and hasattr(usage, "efficiency"):
218	        eff = usage.efficiency()
219	        return eff or None
220	    return result.efficiency()
221	
222	
223	def _commands_block(result: EvalResult, out_dir: Path | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
224	    """The *actual* executed commands (quant recipe + eval calls + self-heal).
225	
226	    Unlike the ``quant``/``eval`` config blocks (which record *intent*), this
227	    captures what really ran -- including an agent-optimized quant command that
228	    replaced the builder, and any deterministic self-heal mutations applied to
229	    the eval invocation. That is what makes a score reproducible byte-for-byte.
230	    """
231	    block: dict[str, Any] = {}
232	    if out_dir is not None:
233	        quant_cmd = _load_quant_command(Path(out_dir))
234	        if quant_cmd and quant_cmd.get("command"):
235	            block["quantize"] = quant_cmd["command"]
236	            block["quantize_source"] = quant_cmd.get("source", "builder")
237	    if result.commands:
238	        block["evaluate"] = list(result.commands)
239	    if result.healed:
240	        block["healed"] = list(result.healed)
241	    return block
242	
243	
244	def write_manifest(manifest: RunManifest, out_dir: Path, *,
245	                   name: str = "run_manifest.json") -> Path:
246	    """Write the manifest as pretty JSON into ``out_dir``; return the path."""
247	    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
248	    path = out_dir / name
249	    path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest.to_dict(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
250	                    encoding="utf-8")
251	    return path

200	    """Recursively download ``remote_dir`` into ``local_dir``; return file count.
201	
202	    Skips weights/caches (the same set excluded from result uploads) so we never
203	    drag multi-GB ``.safetensors`` back over SFTP -- that both wastes bandwidth and
204	    can stall paramiko's prefetch indefinitely (the run's own hf_dataset sink is
205	    what publishes results; this fetch is only for local log/json inspection). A
206	    ``max_bytes`` backstop skips any unexpectedly large blob rather than hanging.
207	
208	    Silently returns 0 if the remote dir does not exist (e.g. run failed before
209	    producing any results).
210	    """
211	    import stat as _stat
212	
213	    from ..report.scrub import EXCLUDED_DIRS, EXCLUDED_SUFFIXES
214	
215	    try:
216	        entries = sftp.listdir_attr(remote_dir)
217	    except OSError:
218	        return 0
219	    count = 0
220	    local_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
221	    for entry in entries:
222	        rpath = f"{remote_dir}/{entry.filename}"
223	        lpath = local_dir / entry.filename
224	        if _stat.S_ISDIR(entry.st_mode):
225	            if entry.filename in EXCLUDED_DIRS:
226	                _log.info("skipping excluded dir %s", rpath)
227	                continue
228	            count += _sftp_fetch_tree(sftp, rpath, lpath, max_bytes=max_bytes)
229	        elif not _stat.S_ISREG(entry.st_mode):
230	            _log.info("skipping non-regular file %s", rpath)  # fifo/socket/device
231	        elif Path(entry.filename).suffix.lower() in EXCLUDED_SUFFIXES:
232	            _log.info("skipping weight/blob %s", rpath)
233	        elif entry.st_size is not None and entry.st_size > max_bytes:
234	            _log.warning("skipping oversized file %s (%d bytes)", rpath, entry.st_size)
235	        else:
236	            try:
237	                sftp.get(rpath, str(lpath))
238	                count += 1
239	            except OSError:
240	                _log.warning("could not fetch %s", rpath)
241	    return count

244	def _exec_stream(client, command: str, *, poll: float = 0.5) -> int:
245	    """Run ``command`` remotely, streaming combined stdout/stderr live; return rc.
246	
247	    lm_eval / vllm report progress with tqdm bars that use carriage returns
248	    (``\\r``) instead of newlines, and phases like model load or a long eval run
249	    for minutes emitting no ``\\n`` at all.  Splitting only on ``\\n`` therefore
250	    makes those phases look hung (while the GPU is clearly busy).  We instead:
251	
252	      * treat both ``\\r`` and ``\\n`` as line delimiters, so each progress update
253	        surfaces as it arrives, and
254	      * block on ``recv`` with a short timeout (no busy-poll) and, when the stream
255	        goes briefly idle, flush any pending partial line so a paused progress bar
256	        or newline-less prompt still shows up.
257	    """
258	    chan = client.get_transport().open_session()
259	    chan.get_pty()
260	    chan.exec_command(command)
261	    chan.settimeout(poll)
262	    buf = b""
263	    while True:
264	        try:
265	            data = chan.recv(65536)
266	        except TimeoutError:
267	            data = b""
268	        if data:
269	            buf += data
270	            parts = re.split(rb"[\r\n]", buf)
271	            buf = parts.pop()  # trailing partial line; completes on a later read
272	            for line in parts:
273	                if line:
274	                    _log.info("[remote] %s", line.decode(errors="replace"))
275	        else:
276	            if buf:
277	                _log.info("[remote] %s", buf.decode(errors="replace"))
278	                buf = b""
279	            if chan.exit_status_ready():
280	                break
281	    if buf:
282	        _log.info("[remote] %s", buf.decode(errors="replace"))
283	    return chan.recv_exit_status()

289	    def __init__(self, **options):
290	        self.options = options
291	        self.remote_root = options.get("remote_root", "~/aqa-runs")
292	
293	    def run(self, run_cfg: RunConfig, *, dry_run: bool = False, resume: bool = False) -> RunResult:
294	        ssh = run_cfg.executor.ssh
295	        if ssh is None:
296	            raise AqaError("executor.type=ssh requires an `ssh:` config block")
297	
298	        run_id = make_run_id(run_cfg)
299	        inner_cfg = build_inner_config(run_cfg, run_id)
300	        secrets = collect_secret_env(run_cfg)
301	        script = build_remote_script(
302	            run_cfg, run_id, has_secrets=bool(secrets), remote_root=self.remote_root
303	        )
304	        dockerfile = _dockerfile_bytes(run_cfg)
305	
306	        printable = " ".join(shlex.quote(a) for a in build_ssh_argv(ssh))
307	        out_dir = Path(run_cfg.output.dir)
308	
309	        if dry_run:
310	            _log.info("[CMD] %s 'bash %s/%s/_dispatch.sh'", printable, self.remote_root, run_id)
311	            _log.info("[dry-run] run_id=%s secrets=%s dockerfile=%s",
312	                      run_id, sorted(secrets), "local/custom" if dockerfile else "none")
313	            _log.info("[dry-run] --- remote dispatch script ---\n%s", script)
314	            _log.info("[dry-run] --- inner run.yaml ---\n%s", inner_cfg)
315	            return RunResult(output_dir=out_dir, state=ProcessState.DONE)
316	
317	        _log.info("[CMD] %s  (staging + docker build/run, run_id=%s)", printable, run_id)
318	        client = _open_client(ssh, timeout=int(self.options.get("timeout", 30)))
319	        try:
320	            sftp = client.open_sftp()
321	            root = self._expand(client, self.remote_root)
322	            work = f"{root}/{run_id}"
323	            _sftp_makedirs(sftp, work)
324	
325	            staged: dict[str, tuple[bytes, int]] = {
326	                "_repo.tgz": (_tar_repo(), 0o600),
327	                "_run.yaml": (inner_cfg.encode(), 0o600),
328	                "_bootstrap.sh": (build_container_bootstrap(run_cfg).encode(), 0o755),
329	                "_dispatch.sh": (script.encode(), 0o700),
330	            }
331	            if dockerfile is not None:
332	                staged["_gpu.dockerfile"] = (dockerfile, 0o600)
333	            if secrets:
334	                env_txt = "".join(f"{k}={v}\n" for k, v in secrets.items())
335	                staged["_secrets.env"] = (env_txt.encode(), 0o600)
336	
337	            for name, (content, mode) in staged.items():
338	                path = f"{work}/{name}"
339	                with sftp.open(path, "wb") as fh:
340	                    fh.write(content)
341	                sftp.chmod(path, mode)
342	
343	            rc = _exec_stream(client, f"bash {shlex.quote(work)}/_dispatch.sh")
344	
345	            # Pull the run's results/logs back so the user can inspect eval logs
346	            # (and gate/accuracy json) locally without SSHing into the box.
347	            remote_results = f"{work}/repo/results/{run_id}"
348	            out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
349	            fetched = _sftp_fetch_tree(sftp, remote_results, out_dir)
350	            if fetched:
351	                _log.info("fetched %d result file(s) into %s", fetched, out_dir)
352	            elif rc != 0:
353	                _log.warning("no result files found on remote at %s", remote_results)
354	            sftp.close()
355	        finally:
356	            client.close()
357	
358	        state = ProcessState.DONE if rc == 0 else ProcessState.FAILED
359	        if rc != 0:
360	            log_hint = next(iter(out_dir.rglob("*.eval.log")), None)
361	            _log.error("remote dispatch failed (rc=%s); remote run %s. %s",
362	                       rc, run_id,
363	                       f"see {log_hint}" if log_hint else f"inspect {out_dir}")
364	        return RunResult(output_dir=out_dir, state=state)

46	
47	`run_5000.sh` exports credentials inline. Here they are read only from the
48	environment variables the YAML names, so keep them in an un-committed file:
49	
50	```bash
51	# env.sh  (add to .gitignore)
52	export GPU_HOST='root@10.239.11.55'        # the direct RTX 5000 Pro host (root login!)
53	export GPU_SSH_PASS='intel@123'            # password for GPU_HOST (never in YAML)
54	export SSHPASS="$GPU_SSH_PASS"             # sshpass reads SSHPASS from env
55	
56	export HF_TOKEN='hf_...'                   # model download
57	export LOCAL_RESULTS_DATASET='lvkaokao/lb_local'
58	export LOCAL_RESULTS_HF_TOKEN='hf_...'     # dataset write token
59

61	export LOCAL_HTTPS_PROXY='http://proxy-ir.intel.com:912'
62

65	```
66	
67	## Run it
68	
69	```bash
70	cd autoquant-agent
71	pip install -e '.[ssh]'          # paramiko for remote dispatch
72	source env.sh
73	
74	# 1. Check the config resolves (env-expansion + schema):
75	aqa validate examples/run_5000.yaml
76	
77	# 2. See exactly what will run remotely, without touching the host:
78	aqa run examples/run_5000.yaml --dry-run
79	#   -> [CMD] sshpass -e ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no kaokao@... 'aqa run run.yaml'
80	
81	# 3. Real run:
82	aqa run examples/run_5000.yaml
83	```

85	## What happens on a real run
86	
87	1. **executor=ssh** connects to `GPU_HOST` (direct; no jump hops) with paramiko,
88	   ships this repo as a tarball into an isolated per-run dir on the host, and
89	   builds the local CUDA Dockerfile (`docker/gpu.dockerfile`) on
90	   `nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.01-py3`.
91	2. **container bootstrap** installs `aqa` + the quant/eval stack (auto-round,
92	   lm-eval) against the NGC base's torch/CUDA, then runs `aqa run` **inside** the
93	   container with `executor.type=local` and `--gpus device=6`.
94	3. **agent-optimize** analyses the model and produces the MXFP8 quant recipe.
95	4. **quantize** runs auto-round `model_free` and exports `llm_compressor` format.
96	5. **baseline eval** runs the bf16 original; **eval** runs the MXFP8 checkpoint on
97	   `piqa,hellaswag,mmlu,gsm8k` via the vLLM backend. With `eval.lm_eval.group: true`,
98	   `piqa+hellaswag+mmlu` run in **one** `lm_eval` call (one model load) and `gsm8k`
99	   runs separately (it needs `--apply_chat_template --fewshot_as_multiturn`).
100	   `eval.lm_eval.model_args` (e.g. `enable_thinking=False,reasoning_parser=qwen3`)
101	   are appended to the vLLM `--model_args`.
102	6. **gate** compares them — NO-GO if MXFP8 drops more than `0.02` vs baseline.
103	7. **fix_loop** root-causes and retries any failing phase; auto-round fixes are
104	   captured as a patch (`agent.patch.capture: true`).
105	8. **sinks** write results to the mounted per-run dir on the host and push a
106	   record to the HF dataset. Results stay under
107	   `~/aqa-runs/<run_id>/repo/results/<run_id>` on the GPU box.

113	> only through a locked-down `--env-file` (never the config, never `ps`). Deeper

355	class HfModelSink:
356	    """Upload a **quantized model** to a Hugging Face *model* repo.
357	
358	    Minimal single-token/single-org port of local_dispatch's ``upload_model_hf.py``:
359	    ``create_repo`` + ``upload_folder`` (with secret/log ignore patterns) plus a
360	    generated model card.  Multi-account failover + quota ledger are intentionally
361	    left out of this first version.
362	
363	    Unlike the result sinks, ``upload``'s first arg is the **model directory**
364	    (the quantized checkpoint), not the eval run dir; the pipeline invokes it with
365	    the quantize provider's output.
366	    """
367	
368	    name = "hf_model"
369	
370	    def __init__(
371	        self,
372	        repo: str | None = None,          # org / owner the repo lives under
373	        *,
374	        repo_name: str | None = None,     # repo id under `repo`; default = artifact name
375	        token: str | None = None,
376	        token_env: str | None = None,
377	        private: bool = False,
378	        endpoint: str | None = None,
379	        disable_xet: bool = False,
380	        model_card: bool = True,
381	        **_: Any,
382	    ):
383	        self.repo = repo
384	        self.repo_name = repo_name
385	        self.token = token
386	        self.token_env = token_env
387	        self.private = private
388	        self.endpoint = endpoint
389	        self.disable_xet = disable_xet
390	        self.model_card = model_card
391	
392	    def _resolve_token(self) -> str | None:
393	        return resolve_hf_token(self.token, self.token_env)
394	
395	    def upload(self, model_dir: Path, meta: RunMeta) -> str:
396	        if not self.repo:
397	            raise AqaError("hf_model sink requires a `repo` (the org/owner to upload under)")
398	        model_dir = Path(model_dir)
399	        if not model_dir.is_dir():
400	            raise AqaError(f"hf_model: model directory not found: {model_dir}")
401	        try:
402	            from huggingface_hub import HfApi
403	            from huggingface_hub.utils import HfHubHTTPError
404	        except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - optional dep
405	            raise AqaError("hf_model sink needs `huggingface_hub`") from exc
406	
407	        token = self._resolve_token()
408	        if not token:
409	            raise AqaError(
410	                "hf_model upload has no token. Set HF_TOKEN (forwarded into the "
411	                "remote container) or configure `token_env: <VAR>` on the sink. The "
412	                f"token must have *write* access under '{self.repo}'."
413	            )
414	        if self.disable_xet:
415	            os.environ.setdefault("HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET", "1")
416	
417	        repo_name = self.repo_name or meta.artifact_name or model_dir.name
418	        repo_id = f"{self.repo}/{repo_name}"
419	
420	        if self.model_card:
421	            self._write_model_card(model_dir, meta, repo_name)
422	
423	        api = HfApi(token=token, endpoint=self.endpoint)
424	        try:
425	            api.create_repo(repo_id=repo_id, token=token, repo_type="model",
426	                            exist_ok=True, private=self.private)
427	            api.upload_folder(
428	                repo_id=repo_id, repo_type="model", folder_path=str(model_dir),
429	                token=token, ignore_patterns=_MODEL_IGNORE_PATTERNS,
430	                commit_message=f"Upload quantized model {repo_name}",
431	            )
432	        except HfHubHTTPError as exc:
433	            status = getattr(getattr(exc, "response", None), "status_code", None)
434	            if status == 403:
435	                raise AqaError(
436	                    f"hf_model upload to '{repo_id}' was denied (403). The token "
437	                    "reached HF but lacks *write* permission under this org/owner. "
438	                    "Use a token whose account can write to "
439	                    f"'{self.repo}' (create/write scope)."
440	                ) from exc
441	            raise AqaError(f"hf_model upload to '{repo_id}' failed: {exc}") from exc
442	        url = f"https://huggingface.co/{repo_id}"
443	        _log.info("quantized model uploaded to %s", url)
444	        return url
445	
446	    def _write_model_card(self, model_dir: Path, meta: RunMeta, repo_name: str) -> None:
447	        results = meta.extra.get("results") if isinstance(meta.extra, dict) else None
448	        try:
449	            (model_dir / "README.md").write_text(
450	                build_model_card(meta, repo_name=repo_name, results=results), encoding="utf-8")
451	        except OSError as exc:  # never block the upload on a card write
452	            _log.warning("hf_model: could not write model card: %s", exc)

44	class HealTally:
45	    """Accumulates the agent self-heal effort spent to *produce* a green run.
46	
47	    The escalating agent fix-loop contributes here, per phase, so the reproducibility
48	    manifest can report how much effort (turns + best-effort tokens) a score cost.
49	    ``record_deterministic`` is retained for backward compat with the manifest schema
50	    (agent-written eval overrides are surfaced via ``EvalResult.healed`` instead).
51	    """
52	
53	    _phases: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
54	
55	    def _slot(self, phase: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
56	        from .agent_eval.stats import TokenStats
57	        return self._phases.setdefault(
58	            phase, {"agent_attempts": 0, "deterministic_heals": 0,
59	                    "tiers": 0, "tokens": TokenStats()})
60	
61	    def record_fix(self, phase: str, fr: FixResult) -> None:
62	        slot = self._slot(phase)
63	        slot["agent_attempts"] += fr.attempts
64	        if fr.attempts:
65	            slot["tiers"] = max(slot["tiers"], fr.tier_index + 1)
66	        slot["tokens"].merge(fr.tokens)
67	
68	    def record_deterministic(self, phase: str, applied: list[str]) -> None:
69	        self._slot(phase)["deterministic_heals"] += len(applied)
70	
71	    def block(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
72	        """Aggregate a manifest ``self_heal`` block (None when no heal happened)."""
73	        from .agent_eval.stats import TokenStats
74	        total_attempts = sum(p["agent_attempts"] for p in self._phases.values())
75	        total_det = sum(p["deterministic_heals"] for p in self._phases.values())
76	        tokens = TokenStats()
77	        for p in self._phases.values():
78	            tokens.merge(p["tokens"])
79	        if total_attempts == 0 and total_det == 0 and tokens.is_empty():
80	            return None
81	        per_phase: dict[str, Any] = {}
82	        for name, p in self._phases.items():
83	            if not (p["agent_attempts"] or p["deterministic_heals"]):
84	                continue
85	            entry: dict[str, Any] = {
86	                "agent_attempts": p["agent_attempts"],
87	                "deterministic_heals": p["deterministic_heals"],
88	                "tiers": p["tiers"],
89	            }
90	            if not p["tokens"].is_empty():
91	                entry["tokens"] = p["tokens"].to_dict()
92	            per_phase[name] = entry
93	        block: dict[str, Any] = {
94	            "agent_attempts": total_attempts,
95	            "deterministic_heals": total_det,
96	            "per_phase": per_phase,
97	        }
98	        if not tokens.is_empty():
99	            block["tokens"] = tokens.to_dict()
100	        return block

212	def _run_quantize(run_cfg: RunConfig, quant_dir: Path, out_dir: Path,
213	                  num_gpus: int = 1, knowledge=None, run_id: str = "",
214	                  heal: HealTally | None = None) -> None:
215	    """Quantize, wrapping the phase in the agent fix-loop when enabled."""
216	    quant_cfg = run_cfg.quant
217	    log_path = quant_dir / "quantize.log"
218	
219	    optimized: str | None = None
220	    if run_cfg.agent.optimize:
221	        _log.info("== agent-optimize (analyse model -> quant recipe) ==")
222	        optimized = _optimized_command(run_cfg, quant_dir, out_dir)
223	        if optimized:
224	            optimized = ensure_device_map(optimized, quant_cfg, num_gpus)
225	            _log.info("using agent-optimized quant command")
226	
227	    # Freeze the *actual* command that will run so the manifest can reproduce it.
228	    if optimized:
229	        record_quant_command(out_dir, optimized, source="agent_optimized")
230	    else:
231	        import shlex
232	        built = build_autoround_command(run_cfg.model, quant_cfg, quant_dir,
233	                                        num_gpus=num_gpus)
234	        record_quant_command(out_dir, shlex.join(built), source="builder")

237	
238	    def _phase() -> PhaseResult:
239	        try:
240	            if optimized:
241	                run_quant_command(optimized, quant_dir, hooks=hook_chain)
242	            else:
243	                run_quantization(run_cfg.model, quant_cfg, quant_dir, num_gpus=num_gpus,
244	                                 hooks=hook_chain)
245	            return PhaseResult(ok=True)
246	        except AqaError as exc:
247	            return PhaseResult(ok=False, log_text=_tail(log_path) or str(exc))

249	    if not run_cfg.agent.fix_loop:
250	        if optimized:

252	        else:

254	                             hooks=hook_chain)

256	
257	    fr = run_fix_loop(
258	        "quantize", _phase, config=_fix_config(run_cfg), out_dir=out_dir,
259	        lesson_store=None, model_id=run_cfg.model,
260	        scheme=quant_cfg.scheme, method=quant_cfg.method,
261	        patch_capture=_make_patch_capture(run_cfg, out_dir),
262	        knowledge=knowledge, replay=run_cfg.agent.knowledge.replay, run_id=run_id,
263	    )
264	    if heal is not None:
265	        heal.record_fix("quantize", fr)
266	    if not fr.ok:

270	def _run_evaluate(run_cfg: RunConfig, model: str, eval_dir: Path,
271	                  out_dir: Path, num_gpus: int, knowledge=None,
272	                  run_id: str = "", phase_name: str = "evaluate",
273	                  heal: HealTally | None = None) -> EvalResult:
274	    """Evaluate, wrapping the phase in the agent fix-loop when enabled.
275	
276	    A phase is considered failed when the harness raises OR every benchmark scores
277	    exactly 0 (acc=0 => fail, matching the leaderboard's failure heuristic). On
278	    failure the fix-loop hands the agent the full traceback and lets it decide --
279	    there is no deterministic pre-pass.
280	    """
281	    holder: dict[str, EvalResult] = {}
282	
283	    def _phase() -> PhaseResult:
284	        try:
285	            res = run_evaluation(model, run_cfg.eval, eval_dir, num_gpus=num_gpus)
286	        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surface as a fixable phase failure
287	            return PhaseResult(ok=False, log_text=str(exc))
288	        holder["result"] = res
289	        if not res.benchmarks:
290	            return PhaseResult(ok=False, log_text="evaluation produced no benchmark results")
291	        # after_benchmark validator hooks (e.g. eval_sanity): an AqaError verdict
292	        # fails the phase and feeds the fix-loop's error signature.
293	        registry = BenchmarkRegistry()
294	        try:
295	            for bench in res.benchmarks.values():
296	                run_hooks("after_benchmark", run_cfg, recipe=registry.get(bench.name),
297	                          result_or_exception=bench, out_dir=eval_dir)
298	        except AqaError as exc:
299	            return PhaseResult(ok=False, log_text=str(exc))
300	        if all(b.score == 0 for b in res.benchmarks.values()):
301	            return PhaseResult(ok=False, log_text="all benchmark scores are 0 (acc=0 => fail)")
302	        return PhaseResult(ok=True)
303	
304	    if not run_cfg.agent.fix_loop:
305	        return run_evaluation(model, run_cfg.eval, eval_dir, num_gpus=num_gpus)
306	
307	    fr = run_fix_loop(
308	        phase_name, _phase, config=_fix_config(run_cfg), out_dir=out_dir,
309	        model_id=run_cfg.model,
310	        scheme=run_cfg.quant.scheme if run_cfg.quant else "",
311	        method=run_cfg.quant.method if run_cfg.quant else "",
312	        patch_capture=_make_patch_capture(run_cfg, out_dir),
313	        knowledge=knowledge, replay=run_cfg.agent.knowledge.replay, run_id=run_id,
314	    )
315	    if heal is not None:
316	        heal.record_fix(phase_name, fr)
317	    if "result" not in holder:
318	        raise AqaError(f"evaluate failed after fix-loop: {fr.reason}")
319	    if not fr.ok:
320	        _log.warning("evaluate fix-loop unresolved (%s); using last result", fr.reason)
321	    return holder["result"]
322

325	                   run_id: str = "", heal: HealTally | None = None):
326	    """Resolve the evaluation target via the configured model provider.
327	
328	    ``pretrained`` returns the model as-is; ``quantize`` runs the (fix-loop-
329	    wrapped) quantization and returns the checkpoint dir; ``endpoint`` returns a
330	    served endpoint.  Quantization is thus one pluggable provider among others.
331	    """
332	    from .providers.base import ProviderContext
333	    from .registry import PROVIDERS
334	
335	    provider = PROVIDERS.create(run_cfg.provider.type)
336	    ctx = ProviderContext(
337	        out_dir=out_dir,
338	        num_gpus=num_gpus,
339	        quantize_fn=lambda quant_dir: _run_quantize(

345	def run_pipeline(run_cfg: RunConfig, out_dir: Path) -> ProcessState:
346	    """Execute the full pipeline; returns terminal ProcessState.
347	
348	    On a phase failure (quantize/evaluate raises after the fix-loop) the run's
349	    artifacts are still written back: eval logs, agent fix records and captured
350	    patches are uploaded via the configured sinks with a failure ``status`` (so a
351	    crashed run is observable on the leaderboard instead of silently vanishing),
352	    and if a valid quantized checkpoint exists it is still pushed to its model
353	    repo. The original error is then re-raised so the caller still sees rc!=0.
354	    """
355	    num_gpus = _num_gpus(run_cfg)
356	    run_id = _make_run_id(run_cfg)
357	    baseline: EvalResult | None = None
358	    resolved = None
359	    eval_dir = out_dir / "eval"
360	    heal = HealTally()
361	    # Shared fix-knowledge (lessons + replayable patches); synced down once here.
362	    knowledge = _make_knowledge(run_cfg)
363	
364	    try:
365	        # ── optional bf16 baseline evaluation ────────────────────────────────
366	        if run_cfg.eval.baseline:
367	            _log.info("== baseline eval (bf16) ==")
368	            base_dir = out_dir / "baseline"
369	            baseline = _run_evaluate(run_cfg, run_cfg.model, base_dir, out_dir,
370	                                     num_gpus, knowledge, run_id,
371	                                     phase_name="baseline", heal=heal)
372	            write_accuracy_json(baseline, base_dir)
373	            _dispatch_sinks(run_cfg, base_dir, RunMeta(
374	                model=run_cfg.model, artifact_name=_artifact_name(run_cfg, "baseline")))
375	
376	        # ── resolve the eval target (provider: pretrained|quantize|endpoint) ──
377	        resolved = _resolve_model(run_cfg, out_dir, num_gpus, knowledge, run_id,
378	                                  heal=heal)
379	        eval_model = resolved.model
380	
381	        # ── evaluation of the (provided) model ───────────────────────────────
382	        _log.info("== evaluate ==")
383	        result = _run_evaluate(run_cfg, eval_model, eval_dir, out_dir, num_gpus,
384	                               knowledge, run_id, heal=heal)
385	        write_accuracy_json(result, eval_dir)
386	
387	        # ── gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
388	        gate_verdict: str | None = None
389	        if run_cfg.gate is not None:
390	            decision = evaluate_gate(result, baseline, run_cfg.gate)
391	            gate_verdict = decision.verdict
392	            (out_dir / "gate.json").write_text(
393	                __import__("json").dumps({"verdict": decision.verdict, "reasons": decision.reasons},
394	                                         indent=2))
395	            _log.info("gate: %s (%s)", decision.verdict, "; ".join(decision.reasons))
396	
397	        results = {n: b.score for n, b in result.benchmarks.items()}
398	
399	        # ── reproducibility manifest (model + config + env + results) ────────
400	        manifest = build_manifest(
401	            run_cfg, result, run_id=run_id, baseline=baseline,
402	            gate_verdict=gate_verdict, out_dir=out_dir, self_heal=heal.block())
403	        write_manifest(manifest, out_dir)
404	
405	        _write_terminal_state(out_dir, ProcessState.DONE, run_cfg.model)
406	        _dispatch_sinks(run_cfg, eval_dir, RunMeta(
407	            model=run_cfg.model,
408	            scheme=run_cfg.quant.scheme if run_cfg.quant else None,
409	            method=run_cfg.quant.method if run_cfg.quant else None,
410	            artifact_name=_artifact_name(run_cfg, "quant"),
411	            run_root=out_dir,
412	            run_id=run_id,
413	            status=_derive_status(results, gate_verdict),
414	            extra={"results": results},
415	            knowledge_dir=knowledge.local_dir if knowledge else None,
416	        ))
417	
418	        # ── optional: upload the quantized checkpoint to a HF model repo ──────
419	        _maybe_upload_model(run_cfg, resolved, result, out_dir)
420	        _finalize_knowledge(knowledge)
421	        return ProcessState.DONE
422	    except AqaError as exc:
423	        _writeback_on_failure(run_cfg, out_dir, eval_dir, resolved, exc, knowledge,
424	                              run_id=run_id, heal=heal)
425	        _finalize_knowledge(knowledge)
426	        raise

436	                  "unresolved=%d hit_rate=%.2f",
437	                  s["replay_hit"], s["reference_used"], s["agent_fixed"],
438	                  s["unresolved"], s["hit_rate"])

444	def _writeback_on_failure(run_cfg: RunConfig, out_dir: Path, eval_dir: Path,
445	                          resolved, exc: AqaError, knowledge=None,
446	                          *, run_id: str = "", heal: HealTally | None = None) -> None:
447	    """Best-effort write-back of a *failed* run (results/logs/patches + status).
448	
449	    Mirrors the success-path sink dispatch so a crashed run is still uploaded and
450	    marked failed on the leaderboard.  If quantization succeeded but evaluation
451	    failed, a valid checkpoint may still exist -- it is uploaded too.  All errors
452	    here are swallowed (we are already unwinding a failure and must re-raise).
453	    """
454	    reason = str(exc)
455	    status = "Quant Failed" if reason.startswith("quantize failed") else "Eval Failed"
456	    run_dir = eval_dir if eval_dir.exists() else out_dir
457	    _log.warning("run failed (%s); writing back partial results + status=%s", reason, status)
458	    _write_terminal_state(out_dir, ProcessState.FAILED, run_cfg.model)
459	    # A failed run still gets a manifest (empty results) so the attempt is auditable.
460	    try:
461	        empty = EvalResult(model=run_cfg.model, backend=run_cfg.eval.backend)
462	        manifest = build_manifest(
463	            run_cfg, empty, run_id=run_id or _make_run_id(run_cfg),
464	            extra_env={"failure": {"status": status, "reason": reason[:500]}},
465	            out_dir=out_dir, self_heal=heal.block() if heal is not None else None)
466	        write_manifest(manifest, out_dir)
467	    except Exception as man_exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - manifest is best-effort
468	        _log.warning("failure-path manifest error: %s", man_exc)
469	    try:
470	        _dispatch_sinks(run_cfg, run_dir, RunMeta(
471	            model=run_cfg.model,
472	            scheme=run_cfg.quant.scheme if run_cfg.quant else None,
473	            method=run_cfg.quant.method if run_cfg.quant else None,
474	            artifact_name=_artifact_name(run_cfg, "quant"),
475	            run_root=out_dir,
476	            run_id=run_id,
477	            status=status,
478	            extra={"results": {}, "error": reason},
479	            knowledge_dir=knowledge.local_dir if knowledge else None,
480	        ))
481	    except Exception as sink_exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - failure write-back is best-effort
482	        _log.warning("failure write-back sink error: %s", sink_exc)
483	
484	    # A successfully quantized model can still be published even if eval failed.
485	    if resolved is not None and status != "Quant Failed":
486	        try:
487	            empty = EvalResult(model=run_cfg.model, backend=run_cfg.eval.backend)
488	            _maybe_upload_model(run_cfg, resolved, empty, out_dir)
489	        except Exception as up_exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - best-effort
490	            _log.warning("failure-path model upload error: %s", up_exc)
491

493	def _write_terminal_state(out_dir: Path, state: "ProcessState", model: str) -> None:
494	    """Refresh ``aqa_run.json`` with the terminal state *before* sinks upload.
495	
496	    The executor writes ``{"state": "running"}`` at start and only rewrites the
497	    final state after ``run_pipeline`` returns — but sink dispatch (the HF
498	    dataset write-back) happens inside the pipeline, so without this the
499	    uploaded artifact would permanently claim "running".
500	    """
501	    meta = out_dir / "aqa_run.json"
502	    if not meta.exists():
503	        return
504	    try:
505	        meta.write_text(__import__("json").dumps({"model": model, "state": state.value}))
506	    except OSError:  # pragma: no cover - cosmetic write, never block the run
507	        pass

510	def _derive_status(results: dict[str, float], gate_verdict: str | None) -> str:
511	    """Status string for the results write-back (mirrors local_dispatch).
512	
513	    An empty result set or any benchmark scoring exactly 0 is treated as an eval
514	    failure, so a forgotten status write-back can't masquerade as success.
515	    """
516	    if not results:
517	        return "Eval Failed"
518	    if any(float(v) == 0.0 for v in results.values()):
519	        return "Eval Failed"
520	    if gate_verdict and gate_verdict.lower() in {"fail", "failed", "reject", "rejected"}:
521	        return "Gate Failed"
522	    return "Finished"

1	"""Stage a run directory for upload: exclude model weights / caches and scrub
2	secrets from text artifacts.
3	
4	Ported from ``local_dispatch/upload_results_hf_dataset.py`` so the aqa results
5	sink writes back the *same* shape local_dispatch did (logs, agent fix records,
6	patches, summaries), minus the quantized weights, with secrets redacted.
7	"""
8	
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import os
12	import re
13	import shutil
14	from pathlib import Path
15	
16	# Suffixes we sanitize as UTF-8 text; everything else is copied byte-for-byte.
17	TEXT_SUFFIXES = {
18	    ".json", ".jsonl", ".log", ".md", ".txt", ".sh", ".py",
19	    ".yaml", ".yml", ".patch", ".diff", ".csv", ".cfg", ".ini",
20	}
21	
22	# Directories that must never be uploaded (weights + caches + vcs).
23	EXCLUDED_DIRS = {
24	    "quantized", "quantized_model", "__pycache__", ".git", ".cache",
25	    ".pytest_cache", ".venv", "venv",
26	}
27	
28	# Weight/blob files that may live outside a weights dir.
29	EXCLUDED_SUFFIXES = {
30	    ".safetensors", ".bin", ".pt", ".pth", ".gguf", ".onnx", ".h5", ".ckpt",
31	}
32	
33	SECRET_PATTERNS = (
34	    re.compile(r"hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}"),
35	    # GitHub token family: ghp_ (personal), gho_ (OAuth), ghu_ (user-to-server),
36	    # ghs_ (server-to-server), ghr_ (refresh), github_pat_ (fine-grained).
37	    re.compile(r"(?:ghp|gho|ghu|ghs|ghr|github_pat)_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}"),
38	    re.compile(r"glpat-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{15,}"),
39	    re.compile(r"\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b"),
40	    re.compile(r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}"),
41	    re.compile(r"(?i)(authorization\s*[:=]\s*bearer\s+)[^\s\"']+"),
42	    re.compile(r"(?i)(x-access-token:***REDACTED***@\s/]+"),
43	    # generic credentials in URL userinfo: scheme://user:secret@host
44	    re.compile(r"(https?://[^/\s:@]+:)[^@\s/]+(@)"),
45	)
46	
47	
48	def sanitize_text(text: str) -> str:
49	    """Redact tokens/secrets from a text artifact before it leaves the machine."""
50	    for pattern in SECRET_PATTERNS:
51	        if pattern.groups:
52	            def _sub(m: re.Match, n: int = pattern.groups) -> str:
53	                # keep every capture group, inserting the redaction after group 1
54	                return m.group(1) + "***REDACTED***" + "".join(
55	                    m.group(i) or "" for i in range(2, n + 1))
56	            text = pattern.sub(_sub, text)
57	        else:
58	            text = pattern.sub("***REDACTED***", text)
59	    return text
60	
61	
62	def stage_run_artifacts(
63	    src: Path,
64	    dst: Path,
65	    *,
66	    extra_excluded_dirs: set[str] | None = None,
67	    sanitize: bool = True,
68	) -> list[str]:
69	    """Copy ``src`` into ``dst`` excluding weights/caches and scrubbing text.
70	
71	    Returns the list of copied paths (relative to ``src``).
72	    """
73	    src = Path(src)
74	    dst = Path(dst)
75	    excluded = set(EXCLUDED_DIRS)
76	    if extra_excluded_dirs:
77	        excluded |= set(extra_excluded_dirs)
78	    copied: list[str] = []
79	    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(src):
80	        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in excluded]
81	        root_path = Path(root)
82	        rel_root = root_path.relative_to(src)
83	        for name in files:
84	            source = root_path / name
85	            if source.suffix.lower() in EXCLUDED_SUFFIXES:
86	                continue
87	            rel = rel_root / name
88	            target = dst / rel
89	            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
90	            if sanitize and source.suffix.lower() in TEXT_SUFFIXES:
91	                try:
92	                    text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
93	                    target.write_text(sanitize_text(text), encoding="utf-8")
94	                except OSError:
95	                    continue
96	            else:
97	                try:
98	                    shutil.copy2(source, target)
99	                except OSError:
100	                    continue
101	            copied.append(str(rel))
102	    return copied

91	def build_inner_config(
92	    run_cfg: RunConfig,
93	    run_id: str,
94	    *,
95	    num_gpus: int | None = None,
96	    output_dir: str | None = None,
97	) -> str:
98	    """Serialize a derived run config for the in-container ``local`` run.
99	
100	    Strips the ssh/proxy executor wiring (that is the *host's* job) and repoints
101	    output at the mounted results dir.  Secrets are never embedded -- they arrive
102	    via the docker ``--env-file``.  Local venv/docker env dispatch passes an
103	    explicit ``num_gpus`` / ``output_dir`` (there is no ssh block to derive from).
104	    """
105	    data = run_cfg.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=True)
106	    # The container is launched with `--gpus device=<ids>`; the in-container run
107	    # sees executor.type=local (no ssh block), so it would otherwise default to a
108	    # single GPU. Carry the host's device count through so the remote pipeline uses
109	    # the right vllm tensor_parallel_size and quantize --device_map.
110	    if num_gpus is None:
111	        ssh_gpus = run_cfg.executor.ssh.gpus if run_cfg.executor.ssh else ""
112	        num_gpus = max(1, len([g for g in str(ssh_gpus).split(",") if g.strip()]))
113	    data["executor"] = {"type": "local", "num_gpus": num_gpus}
114	    data.setdefault("output", {})
115	    data["output"]["dir"] = output_dir or f"{CONTAINER_RESULTS}/{run_id}"

119	def collect_secret_env(run_cfg: RunConfig) -> dict[str, str]:
120	    """Gather env vars to forward into the container (secrets + sink tokens).
121	
122	    Sources: the standard allowlist (when set in the environment) plus any
123	    ``*_env`` keys referenced by output sinks (e.g. ``token_env``).
124	    """
125	    env: dict[str, str] = {}
126	    for name in _SECRET_ALLOWLIST:
127	        val = os.environ.get(name)
128	        if val:
129	            env[name] = val
130	    for sink in run_cfg.output.sinks:
131	        for key, value in sink.model_dump().items():
132	            if key.endswith("_env") and isinstance(value, str) and value:
133	                resolved = os.environ.get(value)
134	                if resolved:
135	                    env[value] = resolved
136	                    # Also expose as HF_TOKEN so huggingface_hub picks it up by default.
137	                    if "token" in key.lower():
138	                        env.setdefault("HF_TOKEN", resolved)
139	    return env

142	def _proxy_pairs(run_cfg: RunConfig) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
143	    proxy = run_cfg.executor.proxy
144	    pairs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
145	    for var, val in (
146	        ("HTTP_PROXY", proxy.http_proxy),
147	        ("HTTPS_PROXY", proxy.https_proxy),
148	        ("NO_PROXY", proxy.no_proxy),
149	    ):
150	        if val:
151	            pairs.append((var, val))
152	            pairs.append((var.lower(), val))
153	    return pairs

156	def build_remote_script(
157	    run_cfg: RunConfig,
158	    run_id: str,
159	    *,
160	    has_secrets: bool,
161	    remote_root: str = "~/aqa-runs",
162	) -> str:
163	    """Bash executed on the remote host: extract -> docker build -> docker run aqa.
164	
165	    All per-run state lives under an isolated ``$ROOT/<run_id>`` directory so
166	    concurrent dispatches to the same machine never collide.  Only the HF cache
167	    and the docker image tag are shared.
168	    """
169	    gpus = run_cfg.executor.ssh.gpus if run_cfg.executor.ssh else "0"
170	    device_list = ",".join(g.strip() for g in str(gpus).split(",") if g.strip())
171	    accelerator = _accelerator(run_cfg)
172	    image = run_cfg.executor.image
173	    dockerfile = (image.dockerfile or "").strip()
174	    if accelerator == "xpu":
175	        base_image = (image.xpu or DEFAULT_XPU_BASE_IMAGE).strip()
176	        device_args = _XPU_DEVICE_ARGS
177	    else:
178	        base_image = (image.gpu or DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE).strip()
179	        device_args = _CUDA_DEVICE_ARGS
180	
181	    proxy_pairs = _proxy_pairs(run_cfg)
182	    proxy_shell = "".join(f'export {k}={shlex.quote(v)}\n' for k, v in proxy_pairs)
183	    build_proxy = "".join(f'    --build-arg {k}={shlex.quote(v)} \\\n' for k, v in proxy_pairs)
184	    run_proxy = "".join(f'    -e {k}={shlex.quote(v)} \\\n' for k, v in proxy_pairs)
185	    env_file_arg = '    --env-file "$WORK/_secrets.env" \\\n' if has_secrets else ""
186	    mounts = (run_cfg.executor.ssh.mounts if run_cfg.executor.ssh else []) or []
187	    mounts_args = "".join(f'    -v {shlex.quote(m)} \\\n' for m in mounts)
188	
189	    tag = f"aqa-gpu:{'local' if dockerfile else 'base'}"
190	
191	    if not dockerfile:
192	        # No build: run the base image directly.
193	        build_section = (
194	            'IMAGE="' + base_image + '"\n'
195	            'echo "== [2/4] docker pull base image (no build) =="\n'
196	            '( set -x; docker pull "$IMAGE" ) || echo "[dispatch] pull failed; using local cache"\n'
197	        )
198	    else:
199	        # Build our shipped Dockerfile (or a custom one) from a clean context dir.
200	        build_section = (
201	            f'IMAGE="{tag}"\n'
202	            'mkdir -p "$WORK/_dockerctx"\n'
203	            'cp "$WORK/_gpu.dockerfile" "$WORK/_dockerctx/Dockerfile"\n'
204	            'echo "== [2/4] docker build (BASE_IMAGE=' + base_image + ') =="\n'
205	            'build_ok=0\n'
206	            'for i in 1 2 3; do\n'
207	            '    if ( set -x; docker build \\\n'
208	            f'{build_proxy}'
209	            f'        --build-arg BASE_IMAGE={shlex.quote(base_image)} \\\n'
210	            '        -f "$WORK/_dockerctx/Dockerfile" -t "$IMAGE" "$WORK/_dockerctx" ); then\n'
211	            '        build_ok=1; break\n'
212	            '    fi\n'
213	            '    echo "[dispatch] docker build attempt $i failed; retrying in 15s..." >&2; sleep 15\n'
214	            'done\n'
215	            '[ "$build_ok" = 1 ] || { echo "[dispatch] ERROR: docker build failed" >&2; exit 1; }\n'
216	        )
217	
218	    return f"""#!/usr/bin/env bash
219	set -euo pipefail
220	
221	ROOT=$(eval echo "{remote_root}")
222	RUN_ID="{run_id}"
223	WORK="$ROOT/$RUN_ID"
224	REPO="$WORK/repo"
225	HF_CACHE_ABS=$(eval echo "~/.cache/huggingface")
226	DEVICE_LIST="{device_list}"
227	CONTAINER="aqa-{run_id}"
228	HOST_UID="$(id -u)"; HOST_GID="$(id -g)"
229	
230	{proxy_shell}mkdir -p "$WORK" "$REPO" "$HF_CACHE_ABS"
231	
232	echo "== [1/4] extract staged repo into $REPO =="
233	tar -xzf "$WORK/_repo.tgz" -C "$REPO"
234	
235	{build_section}
236	echo "== [3/4] stage run config + container bootstrap =="
237	cp "$WORK/_run.yaml" "$REPO/_run.yaml"
238	cp "$WORK/_bootstrap.sh" "$REPO/_bootstrap.sh"
239	chmod +x "$REPO/_bootstrap.sh"
240

269	    """Compute the pip package list installed inside the container.

274	    ``executor.image.pip_install`` are appended (and can pin versions).

131	def _connect(paramiko, *, host, port, user, auth, timeout, sock=None):
132	    """Connect a paramiko client, falling back to keyboard-interactive for
133	    password auth against servers that only offer that method (PAM)."""
134	    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
135	    client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
136	    try:
137	        client.connect(hostname=host, port=port, username=user, timeout=timeout,
138	                       auth_timeout=timeout, banner_timeout=timeout, sock=sock,
139	                       **_auth_kwargs(auth))
140	        return client
141	    except paramiko.AuthenticationException:
142	        if auth.method != "password":
143	            raise
144	        # Retry over the raw transport with keyboard-interactive (same password).
145	        password = os.environ[auth.password_env]
146	        transport = client.get_transport()
147	        if transport is None or not transport.is_active():
148	            client.close()
149	            raise
150	        try:
151	            transport.auth_interactive_dumb(user, lambda *a, **k: [password])
152	        except Exception as exc:
153	            client.close()
154	            raise AqaError(
155	                f"ssh authentication failed for {user}@{host}: check the login user "
156	                f"and the value of ${auth.password_env}"
157	            ) from exc
158	        return client

467	def _expand_env(value: Any) -> Any:
468	    """Recursively expand ``${VAR}`` / ``${VAR:-default}`` in strings."""

485	def _deep_merge(base: dict, override: dict) -> dict:
486	    """Deep-merge ``override`` onto ``base``; ``null`` in override deletes a key."""
487	    out = dict(base)
488	    for key, val in override.items():
489	        if val is None and key in out:
490	            out.pop(key)
491	            continue
492	        if isinstance(val, dict) and isinstance(out.get(key), dict):
493	            out[key] = _deep_merge(out[key], val)

499	def _load_raw(path: Path, _seen: set[Path]) -> dict:
500	    """Load a YAML file, resolving a single ``_base_`` chain (relative to the file)."""
501	    path = path.resolve()
502	    if path in _seen:
503	        raise ConfigError(f"circular _base_ reference at {path}")
504	    _seen.add(path)
505	    if not path.exists():
506	        raise ConfigError(f"config file not found: {path}")
507	    data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text()) or {}
508	    if not isinstance(data, dict):
509	        raise ConfigError(f"config root must be a mapping: {path}")
510	    base_ref = data.pop("_base_", None)
511	    if base_ref:
512	        base_path = (path.parent / base_ref).resolve()
513	        base_data = _load_raw(base_path, _seen)
514	        data = _deep_merge(base_data, data)
515	    return data

528	def _normalize_provider(raw: dict) -> dict:
529	    """Fold a legacy top-level ``quant:`` block into ``provider: {type: quantize}``.
530	
531	    Eval-centric configs use ``provider:``; older quant-centric run.yaml files put
532	    ``quant:`` at the top level.  This shim keeps those working unchanged: a
533	    top-level ``quant`` becomes the quantize provider's config.  Raises if a config
534	    sets both ``quant:`` and a non-quantize ``provider:`` (ambiguous intent).
535	    """
536	    if not isinstance(raw, dict) or "quant" not in raw:
537	        return raw
538	    quant = raw.pop("quant")
539	    if quant is None:  # explicit `quant: null` => eval-only, just drop it.
540	        return raw
541	    provider = raw.get("provider")
542	    if provider is None:
543	        raw["provider"] = {"type": "quantize", "quant": quant}
544	    elif isinstance(provider, dict):
545	        ptype = provider.get("type", "quantize")
546	        if ptype != "quantize":
547	            raise ConfigError(
548	                f"config sets top-level `quant:` but provider.type={ptype!r}; "
549	                "move quant under `provider: {type: quantize, quant: {...}}`"
550	            )
551	        provider.setdefault("type", "quantize")
552	        provider.setdefault("quant", quant)
553	    return raw
554
